narr: Heavy rain caused flooding in portions of the western Florida panhandle.
ev: Santa Rosa County reports a road closure of SR-89 between Pine Level Church Rd and Chumuckla Highway near Jay due to flooding. No injuries have been reported.
Flooding reported at several points east of Jay, including intersections of Dobson and Morristown Rds.
